result:
I've built the adapter, tests and notes. Run on the raw file, `Adapter(file_path="raw/ct_das_y4ub-e4dd_2026-10-15.csv").run()` returns **516 firms** from 7,935 rows, and all 16 tests pass.

- **Which firms count as Black-owned:** a firm is included if any of its rows has `class_description_detailed` equal to exactly `Black American` (1,001 rows). That column is the only place the file records the owner's race. I didn't use "MBE" as a marker, because in Connecticut it also covers women-owned firms: 2,407 MBE rows say "No minority race/ethnicity identified".
- **Duplicate rows:** the file has one row per certification, not one per firm. Matching on the vendor ID in the detail-page link alone would have counted 18 Black-owned firms twice, because the same firm sometimes appears under two IDs. Matching on name alone would miss renamed firms. So rows are grouped as one firm if they share either the vendor ID or the normalized name. Each record takes its details from the firm's most recent row.
- **Expired firms are included.** 188 of the 516 have only expired certifications, but the source still identifies them as Black-owned. Each record keeps its `status`, so keeping only current certifications gives 328 firms.
- **Inconsistent classification:** 8 firms are listed as Black American in some years and "No minority" in others. I included all of them. For 3 of them the latest row says "No minority", which may be worth a manual check.
- **Problems in the file:**
  - `county` is "NA" in every row.
  - `business_state` is blank on all rows before 2023, so 15 returned records have no state. I didn't fill in "CT" because some coordinates are outside Connecticut.
  - ZIP codes are messy; the adapter cuts them to 5 digits and keeps the original value.
  - 32 rows have start dates after the download date, as late as 2028; two of these are Black-owned firms.

`NOTES.md` covers the field mapping and the remaining judgement calls, such as treating two firm names that share one vendor ID as a single renamed firm.

Files are in the current directory:
- `adapter.py`
- `test_adapter.py`
- `NOTES.md`
